_comment: MVP world preset: overworld uses vanilla's own minecraft:noise generator, completely unmodified, paired with vanilla's own standard multi_noise overworld biome source (NOT forced to a fixed ocean biome - see the note in OceanCanvasSurfaceFlattener's class doc for why that caused a severe hang). Terrain, caves, aquifers, ores, structures, and biomes all generate exactly as vanilla. The surface flattening (forcing everything above sea level back to ocean, inside the configured canvas) is NOT done here - it happens in Java via OceanCanvasSurfaceFlattener, listening for chunk-load events. This split exists because NoiseBasedChunkGenerator is final on 26.2 and can't be subclassed, so a custom generator type isn't an option here. Nether and End are left as stock vanilla generators - this mod does not touch them.
